title: Connected host QNN/QNC trace: source anchors and observation contract

source_identity.relation: The reviewed checkout tree matches the requested current-main tree; checkout HEAD is a local commit with the same tree, not a claim that its commit ID is the remote-main ID.

observe: grid%restart and a restart/source provenance flag if available
anchor_map.note: solve_em increments grid%itimestep once at the beginning of this advance. Start-em QNN initialization is separate; do not reinterpret step 1 as proof that the state came from a fresh initialization.

observe: pre/post QNN max and selected cell value
anchor_map.note: For f_qnn, this code conditionally writes QNN only when the selected-domain max is <1. WDM5/6 are NO OP here; NSSL has its own branch. It is not the same assignment as the option-37 driver reset.

anchor_map.selection: Inside other_scalar_advance, instrument only is==P_QNN or is==P_QNC. Preserve the scalar loop's source order and tile coordinates.
observe: scalar_old, scalar before rk_scalar_tend, scalar after rk_update_scalar
advect_tend and scalar_tend at that cell
mu_1, mu_2, mub, c1h, c2h, msfty
selected advection/diffusion settings and whether boundary tendencies were applied
anchor_map.note: rk_scalar_tend computes the configured scalar advection/diffusion tendencies, then rk_update_scalar applies the stage update. The exact cell identity plus timestep, RK stage and tile is required; a timestep-only record cannot establish which RK value was observed.

The QNN boundary routine receives ccn_conc but no density argument; on inflow it assigns ccn_conc directly. This boundary path is conditional; don't infer it ran merely from specified-boundary configuration.

observe: QNN/QNC selected-cell values before and after line 931 initialization
exact selection of the have_udm_cf branch
QNN/QNC/QNR, DEN, P, T, qv, coordinate and units metadata immediately before CALL udm at 2863-2905
anchor_map.note: When have_udm_cf and itimestep==1, this driver writes ccn_conc over the full memory-domain QNN array once before the tile loop. In the selected branch, UDM is called with ccn_preinitialized=.true. and input_density_is_dry=.true. Existing trace_udm_entry_density_state is an available pre-call observation, but its selected location uses a separate column selector and its record needs to be joined to this same grid/timestep/cell.

observe: same cell and timestep QNN/QNC/QNR/DEN immediately after CALL udm returns
actual native RE_CLOUD/RE_ICE/RE_SNOW writes after the return
the same call's DEN and flags
anchor_map.note: The existing post-call trace_udm_radius_state records temperature, QC/QI/QS/QNC, rho, native effective radii and CF state, but not returned QNN. Add a separate QNN/QNC post-call read at the same selected cell if the goal is a true before/after number-state trace. Native cloud radius helper forms rnc=nc*rho at lines 3804-3808 and later uses nc in the lambda expression at 3820-3824; the source-observed input basis remains under review, so record rather than convert.

time_and_restart_semantics.itimestep: solve_em increments grid%itimestep at line 381 before this advance's scalar loops; the driver and UDM receive that value. Record the actual integer every time.
time_and_restart_semantics.rk_stage: RK state may change multiple times within a single itimestep. Record rk_step and dt_rk at the scalar update call; bracket each update rather than sampling only once per model timestep.
time_and_restart_semantics.restart: A nonzero or one-based itimestep alone does not identify fresh versus restarted state. Record grid%restart plus the actual QNN initialization predicates and writes. A restart can retain QNN while first-call reset behavior is controlled separately by driver conditions.
time_and_restart_semantics.cell_identity: Use domain id, i/j tile and selected global i,j plus k; also record scalar index/is and P_QNN/P_QNC symbolic mapping. Join entry/return with the exact same coordinates and current itimestep. Do not join by nearest cell or by timestep alone.

record_sequence: A: startup/input state for selected cell before any QNN initialization; include restart/source identity.
B: after start_em's conditional QNN initialization (if this path is actually entered).
C: option-37 driver initialization at itimestep 1, record before/after the full-domain ccn_conc assignment for selected cell.
D: per RK stage for P_QNN and P_QNC, record before rk_scalar_tend, tendency result, and after rk_update_scalar; separately record specified-flow boundary before/after if its branch is entered.
E: immediately before UDM, reuse/extend the existing entry observer at the identical cell; immediately after UDM, record returned QNN/QNC and the native radius outputs.
minimal_observer_design.anti_aliasing: Use explicit record tags and one monotonically increasing sequence within (domain, itimestep, rk_step, tile, scalar index, cell). Include branch-entered flags; no absent event is equivalent to zero change.
minimal_observer_design.avoid_duplicate_reset: Do not read pre-call QNN only after line 931 and label it as transported state. Store source-event records for the line-931 reset and each RK update separately.

independent_oracles.name: scalar mass-coupling identity
independent_oracles.procedure: Actual module_em.rk_update_scalar in a small manufactured cell/domain; one chosen scalar; zero advective and physics tendencies; controlled distinct old/new mu; no model step.
independent_oracles.source_equation: Mnew*qnew = Mold*qold, with M=c1*(mu+mu_base)+c2, corresponding exactly to the source left-to-right update; check the source expression and floating-point result separately.
independent_oracles.scope: Tests the host mass coupling/decoupling component, not advection and not QNN units.

independent_oracles.name: closed-periodic scalar flux conservation
independent_oracles.procedure: Actual configured advect_scalar implementation and rk_update_scalar on a tiny periodic domain, one scalar and stage, zero physics/diffusion/source terms.
independent_oracles.oracle: Sum source-equivalent layer dry-mass and horizontal metric/area weighted q over the domain; compare with integrated face-flux divergence. The periodic boundary flux must cancel. Capture and independently recompute all selected face fluxes using the same stencil, velocity staggering, map factors, and RK coefficients.
independent_oracles.scope: Tests the configured discrete conservative transport. It cannot settle whether a producer's numerical field means #kg-1 or #m-3.

independent_oracles.name: state-boundary unit/basis trace
independent_oracles.procedure: At same cell/step capture initialization source, every QNN/QNC RK update, UDM pre/post state, dry DEN and consumer output. Distinguish driver reset, specified-boundary inflow, restart retention, and UDM internal clamp events.
independent_oracles.oracle: No universal numeric conversion is imposed. Compare only against a separately authenticated intended storage policy; otherwise report observed assignments and mass/volume transformations without declaring pass/fail on physical units.

limits: Source analysis only. No production source modification, compile, model, solver, actual observer run, or raw scientific array read.
This is an anchor proposal, not permission to instrument or run a model. The actual host runtime route and restart/input population remain unobserved.
The existing entry/radius observers were identified as reusable source sites; no runtime observer semantics or output schema were validated in this task.
Do not infer a density correction from the mass-weighted scalar equation alone. The producer/storage-unit contract and numerical conservation of host transport are distinct questions.
